title: A move out of a place lowers that place; an accepted difference (`adjust`) moves its account and Free to spend or the place it names (decision T7, final_review_3 finding 7, f5); a spend before the opening is not in spent so far (T, SCHEMA 3 corrected)
story: Set up Thu 10 Dec 2026, pay day: the bank holds 300,000, of which 50,000 is kept for a trip, 20,000 for emergencies and 60,000 is Free to spend (typed). Pay of 300,000 on the 10th (moved earlier). A 4,000 spend of Wed 9 Dec, before the opening, is logged from Free to spend: the opening figure already holds it. Sat 12 Dec: 10,000 moves from the trip to the emergency place; a second move of 5,000 back is undone. Sun 13 Dec: outside a check-in, the person accepts a difference of -3,000 on the bank (an `adjust`), from Free to spend. Mon 14 Dec: another -2,000 accepted, from the emergency place they name. Tue 15 Dec: 5,000 moves out of the trip to Waiting. Wallet mode and `hand` are stage 2 and not here. Every amount is made up.
